map.算法：已磨损厚度 = 新品厚度 − 当前厚度；可用剩余厚度 = max(当前厚度: Algorithm: worn thickness = new-pad thickness minus current thickness; available remaining thickness = max(current thickness minus safety limit, 0); driven distance = worn thickness / wear rate times 10000 (km); remaining drivable distance = available remaining thickness / wear rate times 10000 (km); worn percentage = worn thickness / new-pad thickness times 100 percent. Advice grading: below safety limit replace immediately, remaining at or below 5000 km urgent, at or below 10000 km replace soon, at or below 30000 km observe, otherwise good condition.

If current 4 mm, wear rate 1.2 mm/10000 km gives worn 8.00 mm, remaining thickness 1.00 mm, remaining only 8333 km, orange, suggest replacing soon, remaining below 10000 km. If current 2.5 mm (below 3 mm limit) gives warning, urgent replacement, current thickness already below the safety limit.
